CommunityApplications.Profile:
Photos is a self-hosted Google Photos alternative built on Immich, maintained by bdlnaredi. It adds a WhatsApp-style family feed for shared albums, Google Photos styling and a complete Hindi translation.
This repository ships four containers that work together: Photos (the app), Photos-Postgres (database), Photos-Redis (job queue) and Photos-ML (face recognition and smart search). Install the three helpers first, then Photos.
Report problems on GitHub issues.
